simple.meaning: properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove , flee , or (causatively) to drive away

definitions.short: properly, to wave to and fro (rarely to flap up and down); figuratively, to rove , flee , or (causatively) to drive away
definitions.usage: chase (away), × could not, depart, flee (× apace, away), (re-) move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).
definitions.full: H5074. nadad I. [ נָדַד ] verb retreat, flee, depart, stray, wander, flutter (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic flee, run away ; Aramaic hate, abominate, shrink from , Aph`el put to flight , etc.; נְדַד flee ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular נָָֽדְדָה Isa 10:31 ; Est 6:1 ; 3 plural נָָֽדְדוּ Hosea 7:13 4 t., נָדָ֑דוּ Isa 21:15 ; Jer 4:25 ; Imperfect יִדּוֺד Nahum 3:7 ; 3 feminine singular וַתִּדֹּד Gen 31:40 ; 3 masculine plural יִדֹּדוּן Psa 68:13 (twice in verse); Infinitive construct נְדֹד 55:8 ; Participle נֹדֵד Jer 49:5 +; feminine נוֺדֶ֫דֶת Prov 27:8 ; plural נֹדְדִים Hosea 9:17 ; — 1 retreat, flee Isa 21:15 from before ( מִמְּנֵי ) swords ; 33:3 at the sound ( מִקּוֺל ) of tumult ; absolute 10:31 ; 22:3 ; Psa 68:13 (twice in verse), of birds and beasts Jer 4:25 ; 9:9 (+ הָלָ֑כוּ ); participle= fugitive Isa 16:3 ; 21:14 ; of fleeing in horror, disgust, with מִן person Nahum 3:7 ; Psa 31:12 . 2 flee, depart , Israel from ׳י (מִןׅ Hosea 7:13 ; of sleep ( מֵעֵינַי ) Gen 31:40 (E), absolute Est 6:1 . 3 wander, stray (homeless, compare נוד ), נוֺדֵד עוֺף Isa 16:2 (in simile), so Prov 27:8 ( מִן local, in simile), compare 27:8 ( מִן local); of scattered Israel Hosea 9:17 ; Jer 49:5 ; (searching) for food Job 15:23 (wicked man); נְדֹד אַרְתִיק Psa 55:8 I will wander afar. 4 transitive flutter wings (of bird, in figure) Isa 10:14 . Po`el Perfect consecutive וְנֹדַ֔ד זָָֽרְחָה שֶׁמֶשׁ Nahum 3:17 the sun hath arisen and it ( the locust swarm) fleeth away. Hiph`il chase away, Imperfect 3masculine plural suffix יְנִדֻּ֑הוּ וּמִתֵּבֵל Job 18:18 (of wicked, || מֵאוֺר יֶהְדְּפֻהוּ ). Hoph`al be chased away, Imperfect 3masculine singular כְּחֶזְיוֺן וְיֻדַּד Job 20:8 (of wicked); מֻנָֿד קוֺץ 2Sam 23:6 thorns thrust away (si vera lectio, compare Dr.; Klo Bu HPS ׳ק מִדְבָּר ). Hithpo`el. Imperfect יִתְנוֺדְדוּ Psa 64:9 flee away (in horror, disgust, compare Qal Nahum 3:7 ; Psa 31:12 ). [ נְדַד ] verb flee (see Biblical Hebrew I. נדד ); — Pe`al Perfect 3feminine singular עֲלוֺהִי נַדַּת שִׁנְּתֵהּ (K § 46, Beisp. a )) Dan 6:19 .
